newsitem.title: USA: AT&T may announce PCS service launch - analyst.
newsitem.headline: AT&T may announce PCS service launch - analyst.

text.p: AT&T Corp may announce the launch of its next-generation digital PCS (personal communications services) wireless service in a teleconference on Wednesday, one analyst speculated on Tuesday.
The telephone giant said it would hold a news conference to announce the nationwide launch of a new communications service at its New York headquarters at 1130 EDT/1530 GMT.
AT&T declined to comment further on the launch but said it would change the nature of the company's telecommunications.
"The announcement is extremely critical for AT&T," company spokesman Jeff Roberts told Reuters.
The analyst, who asked not to be identified, speculated that AT&T would launch its next-generation wireless service.
